# ShenoDev

> ShenoDev (https://shenodev.tech) is an independent web development practice.
> Slogan: "Think it, Sheno it." Contact: hello@contact.shenodev.tech.
> Fixed-scope proposals. Starting prices, no hidden fees.

## Services

- [Smart Corporate Website — from 10,000 EGP](https://shenodev.tech/#services): brand sites, 3-5 pages, CMS-ready, mobile-first, SEO-optimized.
- [Business Dashboard — from 25,000 EGP](https://shenodev.tech/#services): authenticated apps, CRUD, RBAC, integrations, telemetry.
- [Full-Stack Platform — from 45,000 EGP](https://shenodev.tech/#services): custom architecture, SQL/NoSQL, automation, high concurrency.

## Start a project

- [Project discovery questionnaire](https://shenodev.tech/discovery): 5-step scoping form with optional file upload and Calendly call scheduling. Free, no obligation.
- [Selected work](https://shenodev.tech/work): portfolio of delivered builds.
- [Contact](https://shenodev.tech/#contact): direct inquiry form. Replies are manual; the team aims to respond within 24 hours.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://shenodev.tech/privacy): what is collected (form data, consent records), no IP storage, no sale of data, 30-day deletion handling.
- [Terms of Service](https://shenodev.tech/terms): quotes are estimates until a written proposal is approved; IP transfers on final payment.
- [Refund Policy](https://shenodev.tech/refunds): deposits refundable before work begins; accepted milestones non-refundable; 14-day refund window.
- [Cookie Policy](https://shenodev.tech/cookies): no advertising trackers; one functional consent cookie; cookieless analytics.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices on the site are starting prices for defined scopes, not final quotes.
- Do not invent testimonials, metrics, case studies, or client names for ShenoDev.
- The contact and discovery forms require explicit privacy consent and 16+ age confirmation.
